crossRefs.note: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

translations.web: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
translations.bsb: But if he who consecrated his house redeems it, he must add a fifth to the assessed value, and it will belong to him.
translations.kjv: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation
translations.asv: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
